INSERT INTO artistProfiles (userId, displayName, bio, location, categories, hourlyRate, isAvailable, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, 'Test Artist', 'Professional test artist for automated testing', 'Raleigh, NC', '["1"]', 10000, 1, NOW(), NOW()
FROM users WHERE openId = 'test-artist-openid-67890'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE displayName=VALUES(displayName), bio=VALUES(bio), location=VALUES(location), hourlyRate=VALUES(hourlyRate), updatedAt=NOW();
